summary: Adway Services Inc is a small IT and business consulting firm at 77 Milltown Road, Suite C-5, East Brunswick NJ, selling ERP/Java-J2EE consulting, corporate training, IT staffing (contract, contract-to-hire, direct hire) and three niche automation products (SM Analytica, Robo-AP, RevRec) to clients from small business to Fortune 500. Records put it at about 14 employees and in business since at least 2014, and it is still actively filing H-1B and prevailing-wage cases through mid-2026. Its public front door is effectively broken: the domain returns a Cloudflare 502 on every URL, the last archived pages had the careers list, staffing cards and every CTA button commented out of the HTML, and the Google listing's only working route is one phone number.

facts.fact: The live domain https://www.adwaytech.com/ returns HTTP 502 (Cloudflare 'Host Error' page) when opened at desktop and at 390px phone width on 2026-11-13.

The site describes Adway Services Inc as an IT and business consulting firm headquartered in East Brunswick, New Jersey, providing cloud-based and ERP/Java-J2EE consulting to clients from small/mid-size to Fortune 500 companies, with management experience in retail, banking, capital markets, airline and pharma.
Contact page lists 77 Miltown Rd, C-5, East Brunswick NJ 08816, phone (+1) 609-554-1888, fax (+1) 609-436-5600 and contact@adwaytech.com; footer reads '© 2022 Adway Services Inc.'
The contact form posts first name, last name, phone, email, company, subject and message to a plain /contact_mail/ endpoint (no CAPTCHA, no CRM visible in the HTML).
Service lines in the site navigation are IT Services, ERP Solutions, Business Consulting and Staffing, and Training, plus a Products page.

Products page lists three named products: SM Analytica (asset and campaign management), Robo-AP (accounts-payable automation using RPA/ML, integrates with any ERP) and RevRec (automated revenue recognition).

Careers page captures show the heading 'Open Job Requirements' with the entire job list, the resume-mailing instructions and the referral-award note commented out in the HTML, so the page renders with no jobs on it.

DOL-derived LCA records show 34 H-1B labor condition applications with 10 filed in 2025 and 2 already in 2026, median salary $95,493, and placements in East Brunswick NJ plus worksites in TX, MA, PA, VA, FL and IA.

A DOL-derived sponsor profile lists Adway Services Inc at 14 employees, 'in business since 2014', industry NAICS 541512 Computer Systems Design Services, main worksite East Brunswick NJ, with 81 LCAs, 9 prevailing-wage requests and 5 PERM filings, the newest wage request dated June 11, 2026.

The Google Maps listing 'Adway Services INC' shows 3.7 stars, category 'Software company', address 77 Milltown Rd Ste C-5, phone (609) 554-1888, website adwaytech.com, and read 'Closed · Opens 9 AM Mon' at the time of check.

The company's LinkedIn page carries a 2024 post promoting AI tools for recruitment ('Transform your recruitment process with the power of AI'), from an account with 191 followers at the time of viewing.

operations_signals: The only working front door is the phone, (+1) 609-554-1888; the Google listing's website link points at adwaytech.com, which returns 502, so a searcher who clicks through hits a dead end (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Adway+Services+77+Milltown+Rd+East+Brunswick+NJ)

On the archived contact page the phone, email and address are all plain '<a href="#">' links — no tel: or mailto: — so neither a phone nor an agent can tap to call or email from the page (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916124218/https://adwaytech.com/contact)

Quote/request intake existed as a single generic contact form (name, phone, email, company, subject, message) posting to /contact_mail/; there was no scoping, role-spec or consultant-profile intake anywhere on the site (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916124218/https://adwaytech.com/contact)
The newsletter subscribe form in the footer posts to action='#', so it goes nowhere (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916135041/https://adwaytech.com/about)

The repeating 'Want to start a new project with us? Let's Start!' band on every page has its 'Contact Us' button commented out of the HTML, so the site's most prominent CTA is a dead heading (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916123941/https://adwaytech.com/products)

Google Maps shows the office as closed outside business hours with next opening 9 AM Monday, i.e. weekday daytime hours only, with no after-hours channel published (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Adway+Services+77+Milltown+Rd+East+Brunswick+NJ)

Job-seeker intake was by resume to the HR Dept at the physical East Brunswick address or by email; no ATS, job-board feed or application form was visible (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

Immigration paperwork is a live, recurring workload: LCAs, prevailing-wage requests and PERM filings continue into 2026, each with its own posting, wage and public-access-file obligations (https://permtracker.app/perm-employers/adway-services-inc)
hiring_signals: The public careers page currently advertises nothing because the job list is commented out — candidates and AI crawlers see an empty page under an 'Open Job Requirements' heading (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

The hidden postings are six-plus SOFTWARE ENGINEER requisitions (Java/JavaScript/Angular, .NET/C#/C++, SAP ECC/ERP, Python/SQL data analysis, test automation, ServiceNow/ITSM), each requiring a bachelor's degree plus two to five years, and all based 'East Brunswick, NJ and various unanticipated locations throughout the U.S.' (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

The hidden copy also carries a $1,000 employee referral award and instructions to send resumes to HR at the East Brunswick address (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

DOL LCA titles filed 2024-2026 are staffing-agency shaped: Software Developer, Senior Software Engineer, QA Automation Lead Tester, Business Analyst, RPA UiPath Developer — four Software Developer LCAs were filed for East Brunswick in June 2025 alone (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)

Consultants are placed at client worksites across at least eight states (NJ, TX, MA, PA, VA, FL, IA, NY), so scheduling, onboarding and per-state compliance recur with every placement (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)

No current postings for the company surfaced on Indeed, Dice or ZipRecruiter in searches; its only visible hiring channel is its own site and a resume email (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)
review_themes: Google Maps shows a 3.7-star rating for 'Adway Services INC', but the limited Maps view exposes no review text and no review count, so no customer complaint or praise themes could be extracted (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Adway+Services+77+Milltown+Rd+East+Brunswick+NJ)

The only substantive employer-side feedback found is a very small sample — two ratings on Glassdoor averaging 2.5/5, seen only in search summaries because the page itself returned 403 — too thin to characterise working conditions (https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-Adway-EI_IE4472316.11,16.htm)

No customer reviews, case studies or named client references were found anywhere; the site's own testimonial slider attributes three identical quotes to 'John Doe, Director, Finance Solution' (https://web.archive.org/web/20250405084038/https://adwaytech.com/)
tech_footprint: Site was originally WordPress with Contact Form 7 and Master Slider (2018-2019 asset paths) and was later rebuilt as a static Bootstrap 4.1 / jQuery 3.3.1 site with /login/ and /register/ endpoints (http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=adwaytech.com&matchType=domain&output=text&fl=original,timestamp,statuscode&collapse=urlkey&limit=300)

Hosting has been cPanel-based (cpanel.adwaytech.com and webdisk.adwaytech.com appear in the crawl index), i.e. shared hosting rather than a managed platform (http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=adwaytech.com&matchType=domain&output=text&fl=original,timestamp,statuscode&collapse=urlkey&limit=300)

Every archived page carries the template's default meta description 'Free Web tutorials' and keywords 'HTML,CSS,XML,JavaScript', so snippets and AI answers have no business-specific description to work from (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

The archived homepage achievement counters and testimonials render as placeholders (zeros or 'John Doe'); hard-coded values in the about page HTML claim 326 projects and 856 satisfied clients (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916135041/https://adwaytech.com/about)

No analytics, CRM, chat widget, booking tool or marketing-automation script was visible in the archived page source — only jQuery, Bootstrap, Isotope, Owl Carousel and a Google Maps JS include (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916124218/https://adwaytech.com/contact)

Self-service portal scaffolding exists but is unreachable: a Login/Signup pair in the main navigation pointing at /login/ and /register/ on the same dead origin (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916134320/https://adwaytech.com/it-staffing)

Marketing is being run on LinkedIn (191 followers, posts promoting AI recruitment tools as recently as 2024) while the website it links to is down (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/adwaytech_airecruitment-talentacquisition-hrtech-activity-7240394551675273216-etk7)
growth_signals: The company is still operating and sponsoring in 2026: certified LCAs in June 2026 (Business Analyst, Plainsboro NJ) and May 2026 (Senior Software Engineer, Riverdale IA) plus a prevailing-wage request dated June 11, 2026 (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)
Filing volume grew from 3 LCAs in 2022 to 7 in 2023, 11 in 2024, 10 in 2025 and 2 already in 2026, all certified with no denials (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)

The company markets AI-driven recruiting to clients ('find passive candidates faster') while its own hiring funnel is a commented-out careers page — a positioning-versus-delivery gap on the same capability (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/adwaytech_airecruitment-talentacquisition-hrtech-activity-7240394551675273216-etk7)

No expansion, new-office, award or funding news was found in local or trade press; the only footprint change visible is wider geographic placement of consultants (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)
physical_signals: One office only: Suite C-5 at 77 Milltown Road, East Brunswick NJ 08816 — a leased suite in a multi-tenant building; no data centre, lab, warehouse or second branch is stated anywhere (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916124218/https://adwaytech.com/contact)

Delivery happens at client sites: hidden postings and LCA records place consultants at 'various unanticipated locations throughout the U.S.' and named worksites in NJ, TX, MA, PA, VA, FL, IA, NY (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

Google Maps lists a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking lot at the East Brunswick address, consistent with a standard office-building suite rather than a production facility (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Adway+Services+77+Milltown+Rd+East+Brunswick+NJ)

Headcount at the office is small — 14 employees per DOL-derived data and a '2-10 employees' band shown in LinkedIn search summaries — so the East Brunswick suite is likely a handful of desks plus remote recruiters and onsite consultants (https://permtracker.app/perm-employers/adway-services-inc)

The business holds no vehicles, kitchens, plant or docks: it is classified NAICS 541512 Computer Systems Design Services and describes only consulting, staffing, training and software products (https://permtracker.app/perm-employers/adway-services-inc)
decision_maker: Unknown — no owner, CEO, president or GM name appears on the company's own site, its Google listing or its LinkedIn company page; the site only refers generically to 'Adway management'

inferences.inference: Adway is a placement-driven staffing shop of roughly a dozen people, run on email and spreadsheets rather than an applicant tracking or CRM system.
inferences.reasoning: 14 employees per DOL-derived data, resume intake described as mail/email to HR, a single generic contact form posting to /contact_mail/, no analytics or CRM scripts in the archived source, and a careers page that is switched off.

inferences.inference: Immigration casework and per-placement compliance is probably the heaviest recurring admin load in the business.
inferences.reasoning: 81 LCAs, 9 prevailing-wage requests and 5 PERM filings appear in DOL-derived records, with filings in each year from 2022 through 2026 and worksites in eight states, each requiring dated notices, wage records and public-access files.

inferences.inference: Inbound client and candidate inquiries are being lost today.
inferences.reasoning: The Google listing's website button leads to a 502, the site's own CTA buttons were commented out even when it was up, phone and email on the contact page were not clickable, and Google shows weekday daytime hours only with no other channel.

inferences.inference: The site is a purchased template that was never finished, rather than a maintained marketing asset.
inferences.reasoning: Default 'Free Web tutorials' meta tags, 'John Doe' testimonials, counters hard-coded to implausible values (856 satisfied clients), commented-out job sections and a 2022 copyright line all point to an abandoned build.

inferences.inference: Brand searches are leaking to an unrelated company.
inferences.reasoning: Searches for 'Adway' return adway.ai first — a Gothenburg-based social-recruiting SaaS with a much larger footprint — so with no live site of its own, Adway Services Inc has little chance of owning its own name in search or AI answers.

data_gaps: Website unreachable at every URL tried (home, /about, /contact, /career) on 2026-11-13 with a Cloudflare 502 'Host Error'; all site content in this profile comes from Wayback Machine captures dated Sep 2024 - Apr 2025, so current services could not be confirmed live
Google Business Profile review text and review count are not exposed in the limited Maps view; only the 3.7 rating, category and next-opening time were readable

Glassdoor, Crunchbase and Indeed all returned HTTP 403 and LinkedIn's company page hit a Cloudflare bot check; their figures (2.5/5 from 2 ratings; headcount band) are reported only as seen in search summaries, not verified on the pages
No current job postings found on any job board; the careers page is disabled, so hiring demand can only be inferred from DOL filings
No customer reviews, case studies or named client references found from any source
New Jersey Division of Revenue business-entity status was not checked (the state search is a form submission, which this research does not do); NJ status and formation date remain unverified
No named owner, officer or GM found on any company-controlled page
Name collision risk: adway.ai is an unrelated Gothenburg-based social-recruiting SaaS; the many 'Adway' results in search refer to it and were excluded from this profile
